name: Eluzai
overview: Eluzai was a male figure who came to David's aid at Ziklag, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 12:5. Scripture notes his arrival to support David at Ziklag, highlighting his role in the gathering of those loyal to David during a critical period. His tribal affiliation is not specified in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Eluzai means 'G-d is my strength,' reflecting a declaration of trust in God's power. This proper name emphasizes reliance on divine strength, consistent with the faith of those who supported David.
familyAndRelationships: Eluzai is explicitly identified as a descendant of Benjamin, linking him to this Israelite tribe. Beyond this, Scripture does not record additional family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Eluzai's significance lies in his support for David during the time at Ziklag, a pivotal moment when David was consolidating his followers. His presence among those who joined David demonstrates the gathering of faithful men who recognized God's plan for David's kingship. This support was crucial for the establishment of David's future reign over Israel.
